annotations.title: Validate an origin's manifests and grade it

description: Validate a public origin's agent-facing manifests against their specifications and grade its agentic-web readiness. Input: origin; optional id to check one manifest only (ard, ai-catalog-well-known-file, mcp-server-cards, a2a, llms-txt, agents-md, api-catalog-rfc9727, ai-crawler-tokens-robots, security-txt, auth-md). Returns grade A+ to F with the rubric, per-manifest errors (spec violations) and warnings (best practice), steps covered, what an agent can call, and the cheapest next steps. The same report is a page at /check/<domain>/ with a badge at /badge/<domain>.svg.
name: validate_manifest
